summary: The state is not sealed. Attributes, outputs and stored plans are stored as plain text, and anyone who can read s3://acme-state/estate can read every value.

file.text: The state is not sealed, so there is no list of readers to compare.

suggestions.title: Seal the state
suggestions.why: Sealing encrypts attributes, outputs and stored plans to the readers in the file. It needs the store at rest, so announce a short freeze.
suggestions.who: each reader, then one of them

steps.text: On the machine of each reader:
On the machine of the reader who seals, add the line each reader sent, one for each, to the readers file:
